# 01 Freeze class-diagram contracts, parse core class syntax, and add `%%` comments everywhere

## Outcome

`contracts.ts` exports the full class-diagram type surface for the whole board (including the
namespace/note/interaction/styling shapes later tickets implement), and `SirenDocument` gains its
third `kind`. `parseSiren` recognizes `classDiagram` (and the `classDiagram-v2` alias), strips
`%%` comment lines for **every** diagram kind before dispatching, and delegates to a new
`parseClassDiagram`, which parses classes, members and all eight relationship forms.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `%%` comment lines are ignored in flowchart, sequence **and** class documents: a whole-line
  comment, an indented one, and a trailing one after real syntax (`A --> B %% note`). Existing
  flowchart and sequence tests keep passing unmodified.
- [ ] A document whose only content is comments produces an error diagnostic (no header found),
  not a crash.
- [ ] `parseSiren` on a `classDiagram` document returns `kind: "class"`; `classDiagram-v2` is
  accepted as the same header.
- [ ] `parseClassDiagram` on:
  ```
  classDiagram
    Animal <|-- Duck
    class Fish {
      +int size
      -String name
      +swim() bool
    }
    Bird : +fly()
  ```
  produces classes `Animal`, `Duck`, `Fish`, `Bird` (the first two created implicitly by the
  relationship), `Fish` with two attributes and one method, `Bird` with one method from the inline
  form, and one relationship.
- [ ] All eight relationship forms (`<|--`, `*--`, `o--`, `-->`, `--`, `..>`, `..|>`, `..`) parse
  into the `{ line, fromEnd, toEnd }` model from spec.md's Domain decisions, in both directions
  where Mermaid allows the mirrored spelling (`--|>`, `--*`, `--o`, `<--`, `<..`, `<|..`).
- [ ] A relationship's `: label` and both multiplicity strings (`Customer "1" --> "*" Ticket`)
  parse into the relationship.
- [ ] Member lines preserve visibility markers, classifiers, types, parameter lists and return
  types verbatim enough to reconstruct the source line.
- [ ] Malformed input (an unterminated `class X {` block, an unrecognized statement) returns
  `document: null` plus at least one error diagnostic; never throws.
- [ ] `contracts.ts` exports `ClassDocument`, `ClassDecl`, `ClassMember`, `ClassRelationship`,
  `ClassRelationshipLine`, `ClassRelationshipEnd`, `ClassNamespace`, `ClassNote`,
  `ClassInteraction`, `ClassStyleDecl`, `ClassModel`, `ClassModelResult`,
  `PositionedClassDiagram` and its constituents, matching spec.md's Design contract.

## Test seam

`parseSiren(source: string): ParseResult` (dispatch and comment stripping, all three kinds) and
`parseClassDiagram(source: string): ParseResult` — unit level, pure functions.
